text:
Subject: Broken heater at [address], repair needed

Dear [landlord's name],

I'm writing to let you know that the heater in my home stopped working on [date]. [What happens, e.g. there is no heat, it makes a strange noise, or it won't turn on].

Could you please arrange a repair within [e.g. 48 hours]? With [cold weather / the loss of heat affecting daily living], this has become quite urgent. I'd be grateful if you could reply to confirm when someone will come.

I'm available for a visit on [days and times], and you can reach me on [number] if that's easier.

Thank you for your help with this. I appreciate your quick attention.

Kind regards,
[your name]
